Marissa / Ben — forwarding Crescent Dynamics thread. Quick summary for context: prospect ran an LLM-heavy eval; asking for a one-time 300k token trial top-up (to be applied now) plus confirmation we can hold pilot pricing if they sign with a July 1 start. They are a mid-market product org, likely $180k ARR first-year if we secure a modest commit; strategic because they have integrations in our west region and a possible reference use case for enterprise search.

Why I'm asking: the credits alone are within quota, but combined with a pricing carveout (effectively locking a lower rate for a delayed start) is outside my delegated authority. Proposed concession package:
- One-time trial credit: 300k tokens applied to May usage
- Pilot pricing guaranteed until contract signature if LOI received by May 14
- 30% one-time discount on first month of committed usage upon sign (to smooth the transition)

Impact and guardrails:
- Total expected cost to Redwood if accepted: estimated $9.5k in token spend + $8k revenue erosion from the 30% smoothing discount (rough math attached).
- Require standard EOA language: credits are promotional, non-recurring, and applied only to evaluation billing.
- DocuSign to follow; legal OK with an LOI + standard SOW modifications.

Request: Executive signoff to grant combined concession (credits + pricing hold + one-time smoothing discount) for Crescent. If approved, I'll send the conditional LOI template to Jordan and route the DocuSign.

Attached: usage report, draft SOW, rough cost calc.

Thanks — Tessa

Jordan / Samira — good news. Leadership and finance have approved a conditional concession package. Summary of approved terms (conditional):

1) One-time trial credit: 300,000 tokens to be applied immediately to May evaluation billing.
2) Pilot pricing hold: We will hold the quoted pilot pricing through contract signature provided we receive a signed LOI by May 14 that includes an estimated initial commit range and acknowledges the July 1 start date.
